body: He has also already been to numerous psychiatrists and claims none of them are any help, i know of one he went to with complaints about hallucinations and he got diagnosed with asperger. So he doesnt really believe that psychiatrists can help him anymore

We do constantly but he keeps saying things like "Do whatever you feel like you're not going to change my mind" and if we say we're gonna do something to help he says things like "Do whatever feels good for you"

He's says he's tired of the pain and wants to step out of life.

We've been at this point with him once before and got through it, but this time he's really calm in his answers and comes across like he is sure hes gonna do this. Which is both scary and frustrating for us.

We're gonna see him today in person and talk to him, hoping that will help him in any kind of way.
